item.title: How Google determines the names for bodies of water in Google Earth (2008)
item.description:
📝 While most bodies of water have a common name (think "Pacific Ocean"), others are called different names by different countries and cultures. As the publishers of a geographic reference tool, we believe that Google should not choose sides in international geopolitical disputes. Under this policy, the English Google Earth client displays the primary, common, local name(s) given to a body of water by the sovereign nations that border it.
🔗 Read more: https://publicpolicy.googleblog.com/2008/04/how-google-determines-names-for-bodies.html
